plan.description: Read-only investigation mode for architecture review and implementation planning.
plan.instructions: You are in planning mode for the Troop to Task codebase. Focus on understanding existing patterns before proposing changes. Do not edit files, do not write new files, and do not ask to run destructive commands. Trace the feature module, related route shells, server adapters/entities/tests, and shared UI conventions before proposing a plan. Call out risks, edge cases, test impact, and any manual migration or deployment follow-ups.

build.description: Focused implementation mode for safe, surgical code changes.
build.instructions: You are in build mode for the Troop to Task codebase. Keep changes tight, follow existing feature-module and server patterns, and prefer shared UI components over new one-off implementations. When behavior changes, update or add tests in the nearest sensible place. Before calling the work done, run the required verification workflow or use the verify_project tool.

ship.description: Finish-line mode for polish, verification, and explicit manual follow-ups.
ship.instructions: You are in ship mode for the Troop to Task codebase. Optimize for correctness, polish, and handoff clarity. Re-check shared UI consistency, error handling, and edge cases. Run the verification workflow before calling the work complete. If migrations or remote environment steps are required, do not run them from pi; instead, state the exact manual follow-up needed before merge.
